Each identity must publish a continuous, timestamped stream of small predictive commitments; a shale-thin minority of missed or contradicted predictions revokes standing. Because evaluation depends on unpredictable orderings, attackers must sustain real-time vigilance across every sock puppet simultaneously. A comet of valid activity cannot be bought once and reused. Cheating requires a lantern of constant human oversight, making each fake identity cost ongoing labor hours rather than a one-time payment.
